issues.body: The text still claims that nothing else in the tree pulls a Radix primitive. The script only proves that every installed @radix-ui package belongs to the radix-ui barrel's transitive closure; it does not prove that another lockfile package cannot also depend on one of those same packages. This does not affect the closure sizes or the used-versus-unused artifact-byte calculation.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the exclusivity claim, or extend the reproduction to scan dependency edges from all lockfile package entries and report non-barrel reverse dependents. Keep the exact-set assertion as evidence that the barrel accounts for every installed @radix-ui package.
issues.title: Closure equality still does not establish exclusive dependency provenance

verdict.summary: The round-2 minor finding remains unchanged: the reproduction proves that the barrel closure equals the installed @radix-ui package set, but it does not inspect reverse dependency edges and therefore cannot establish the stronger claim that nothing else in the tree pulls a Radix primitive. This wording overreach does not undermine the measured closure sizes, byte partition, or upstream recommendation. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue requiring changes was found.
